name: com.pinkwallet/agentic-payments-sandbox
description: Approval layer for AI agent payments: budgets, rules, human approval. Sandbox, test credentials.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional. OAuth 2.1 is available (discovery at /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server, dynamic client registration, PKCE S256, consent page); or a Bearer sandbox agent key (pk_sandbox_agent_*) issued by POST /v1/sandbox/workspaces or the create-workspace form at https://agentic-sandbox.pinkwallet.com/.

environmentVariables.name: PINK_AGENT_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Agent API key from a Pink sandbox workspace (create one free, no signup, at https://agentic-sandbox.pinkwallet.com or via `npx pink-agentic-payments-mcp --create-sandbox`).

environmentVariables.name: PINK_MCP_URL
environmentVariables.description: Remote Pink MCP endpoint to bridge to. Defaults to the public sandbox: https://agentic-sandbox.pinkwallet.com/mcp
